title: Pilot compatibility with different classes of UAP

tellings.quote: I might work very well with object A but I can't work with object B or C.

plain: Between 2008 and 2010, at a place in New York called Baker Victory Services, children were tested to see which kinds of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, they could work with as pilots. A man named Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into such a program as a child, tells Michels that a person "might work very well with object A but I can't work with object B or C," which would mean the craft are matched to particular people.
